name: Brute-Force Authentication Attack
description: Simulated SSH brute-force attack leading to successful authentication, privilege escalation, and data exfiltration.
expected_detections: Multiple accounts targeted by one source IP
attack_narrative: Attacker from 192.168.100.5 performed an SSH brute-force attack against webserver-01, trying multiple usernames. After 17 failures across 6 usernames, successfully authenticated as 'ubuntu'. Escalated to root via sudo, accessed /etc/shadow and /etc/passwd, created a backdoor user, then exfiltrated data via a reverse connection to port 4444.
